title: Your Cat Doesn’t Know Prime Day Ends Tonight. You Do
author: Molly Higgins
text:
All products featured on WIRED are independently selected by our editors. However, we may receive compensation from retailers and/or from purchases of products through these links. Learn more.Amazon Prime Day now happens several times a year, including Prime Big Deal Days, which end tonight. This sales event is the best time for pet parents to snag an otherwise expensive automatic litter box or pet camera for much less money before prices dip again before Black Friday and Cyber Monday sales.As the Reviews team’s pet tech reviewer, I’ve tested many great pet gadgets, as well as many that don’t live up to their promises. I’ve scoured Amazon to find the best discounts on WIRED-tested pet tech that I think is actually worth buying during Amazon Prime Big Deal Days. Want more Amazon Prime Day deals? Read our Absolute Best Prime Big Deal Days deals roundup and live blog.Be sure to check out our related Amazon Prime Day shopping guides to ensure you’re making the most of the sales, including how to avoid scams and sketchy wares on Amazon, Amazon Prime perks you might not know about, and Amazon Prime Day tips.WIRED Featured DealsOur favorite automatic cat litter box: Petkit Purobot Max Pro 2 for $443 ($107 off)A cheap pet camera: Petcube Cam 360 for $33 ($14 off)An AI-enabled automatic feeder with a camera: Petkit YumShare Dual-Hopper 2 Automatic Feeder for $130 ($50 off)Jump toBest Pet Camera DealsBest Automatic Feeder DealsBest Pet Fountain DealsBest Automatic Litter Box DealsBest At-Home Pet DNA Test KitsMost PopularGearThe Roborock Qrevo 2 Pro Is One of My New Favorite Budget VacuumsBy Nena Farrell Buying GuidesANC vs. NYC: We Put the Best Noise-Canceling Earbuds to the Ultimate TestBy Harry RabinowitzGearThe Top New Features in Apple’s iOS 27 and iPadOS 27By Julian ChokkattuHow To and AdviceTry These 3 iOS 27 Safari Settings to Get More Out of Apple’s BrowserBy Reece RogersUpdated 4 pm ET October 7: I’ve added fresh deals and ensured up-to-date prices.Best Pet Camera DealsI’ve tested nearly two dozen pet cameras. They can be expensive, but I find them immensely helpful, especially when I’m out of town or when I keep finding surprise piles of puke scattered across the carpet. I recommend these models, and they just so happen to be heavily discounted right now.Photograph: Molly HigginsCourtesy of AmazonTkenpro2K Pet Camera Treat Dispenser$90 $70 (22% off) AmazonThis was my favorite pet camera for a long time. It has 360-degree views, two-way audio, and dispenses treats to make your pets feel a little less alone.Photograph: Molly HigginsPetcubeCam$60 AmazonThis is a basic but solid pet camera. This is the lowest price we’ve seen this year—you can’t get much cheaper than this.
Photograph: Molly HigginsCourtesy of FurboFurbo360 Dog Camera$122 Amazon$184 $54 (71% off) Furbo$131 NeweggThis pet camera has 360-degree panning and can even toss treats while you’re away. At $85, this price beats the lowest we’ve seen by 30 percent.

It has an optional mount and pans 360 degrees, as well as up and down, so you can see virtually every inch of the room. There's also an intuitive connected app that sends alerts if anything's amiss.Best Automatic Feeder DealsAn automatic pet feeder is a godsend for pet parents with a furbaby who likes to wake you up by screaming at 3 am for food. It also gives me peace of mind while I’m away. I recommend that every pet owner have one.Photograph: Molly HigginsCourtesy of PetlibroPetlibroOne RFID Smart Feeder$150 Amazon$150 PetlibroMost PopularGearThe Roborock Qrevo 2 Pro Is One of My New Favorite Budget VacuumsBy Nena Farrell Buying GuidesANC vs. NYC: We Put the Best Noise-Canceling Earbuds to the Ultimate TestBy Harry RabinowitzGearThe Top New Features in Apple’s iOS 27 and iPadOS 27By Julian ChokkattuHow To and AdviceTry These 3 iOS 27 Safari Settings to Get More Out of Apple’s BrowserBy Reece RogersBy using a special tag that is worn by only the pet you want to access the food, this automatic feeder is ideal for greedy pets or pets with special diets in a multi-pet home. It can be scheduled and managed through the app, or you can go analog with the front knob to program meal schedules.Best Pet Fountain DealsEnsuring your pet stays hydrated with an automatic pet fountain is one of the easiest ways to be proactive about their health, especially for cats prone to UTIs and bladder infections.Photograph: Molly HigginsPhotograph: Molly HigginsPetkitEverSweet Ultra with AI Camera Pet Water Fountain$250 Amazon$250 $211 (16% off) PetkitYou can't ask for much more than what this luxe pet fountain delivers—a built-in, AI-enabled camera to watch from afar and track hydration; a connected app to monitor and get cleaning reminders; and a wastewater tank system that aids in deep cleaning. It's a pricey upgrade, but made a little easier to stomach with this discount.Most PopularGearThe Roborock Qrevo 2 Pro Is One of My New Favorite Budget VacuumsBy Nena Farrell Buying GuidesANC vs. NYC: We Put the Best Noise-Canceling Earbuds to the Ultimate TestBy Harry RabinowitzGearThe Top New Features in Apple’s iOS 27 and iPadOS 27By Julian ChokkattuHow To and AdviceTry These 3 iOS 27 Safari Settings to Get More Out of Apple’s BrowserBy Reece RogersPhotograph: Molly HigginsPetkitEverSweet Solo SE$30 Amazon$30 $23 (23% off) PetkitIf you’re interested in trying a fountain to see if it’s right for your pet, this basic model is a good place to start—and it’s the lowest price we’ve seen this year.
Photograph: Molly HigginsCourtesy of AmazonPetlibroDockstream Fountain$70 $62 (11% off) AmazonPetlibro released a second-generation version of this model earlier this year, but I still think this cordless model is worth buying. Right now, it’s also 12 percent cheaper than we’ve ever seen it.
Photograph: Kat MerckCourtesy of Brook FountainsBrookGlass Pet Fountain$90 AmazonMost PopularGearThe Roborock Qrevo 2 Pro Is One of My New Favorite Budget VacuumsBy Nena Farrell Buying GuidesANC vs. NYC: We Put the Best Noise-Canceling Earbuds to the Ultimate TestBy Harry RabinowitzGearThe Top New Features in Apple’s iOS 27 and iPadOS 27By Julian ChokkattuHow To and AdviceTry These 3 iOS 27 Safari Settings to Get More Out of Apple’s BrowserBy Reece RogersThis glass fountain is highly hygienic, keeping water cool and requiring less cleaning than plastic models. It's simple yet looks like a sculptural art piece, anchored by a heavy, 10.25-inch straight-sided, flat-bottomed glass bowl and an adjustable suction-cup-bottomed pump that can go wherever in the bowl you want. The pump is also completely silent, and the bottom blue LED light adds visual interest. WIRED editor Kat Merck’s two cats have been using it for over a year, and it's still going strong.Best Automatic Litter Box DealsAlthough they are pricey, I recommend that every single cat parent invest in an automatic litter box. Amazon Prime Big Deal Days is one of the best times to buy.Photograph: Molly HigginsPhotograph: PetkitPetkitPuraMax 2$390 $300 (23% off) Amazon$449 $370 (18% off) Walmart$500 $376 (25% off) PetkitAlthough Petkit has released a few newer models, this is still the automatic litter box I recommend to most people. It performed reliably during extended testing, and it’s currently at its lowest price of the year.
Photograph: Molly HigginsCourtesy of PetkitPetkitPurobot Max Pro 2$550 $500 (9% off) Amazon$600 $442 (26% off) Petkit$530 WayfairThis is the best overall automatic litter box, now 20 percent off. It features an AI-enabled camera and a connected app to better track and monitor usage, providing enhanced health insights.
